items.html: And with this you will understand what was explained in the discourse that preceded this: that Rosh HaShanah is the head and Keter of ZA, even though all the months are in the female, as is known. But the explanation of the matter is that on the first day nothing is sawed except the aspect of the judgments in the Keter of the male, to give them in her Keter, from his head to her head. And it follows that the secret of Rosh HaShanah is the head of the male and also the head of the female: this one gives and this one receives, and both are true.
